results.question: How many products are there in each product category?

results.question: What is the average order amount for each customer region?
results.expectedSql: SELECT c.region, AVG(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region
results.agentSql:
SELECT 
    c.region,
    COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2), 0) AS avg_order_amount
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY c.region

results.question: Which product has sold the most units in total? Give its name and the number of units.
results.expectedSql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1
results.agentSql:
SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Who are our best customers?
results.answer: When you say 'best customers', which metric would you like to use?

results.question: Which products perform best?
results.agentSql:
SELECT 
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category AS category,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
    CAST(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price) AS REAL) AS total_revenue
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
